meta.title: Prompt enhance
meta.description: Adds an enhance button to the right of the composer. One click sends the draft, its @-references and the attachments already in the composer, plus the last two conversation rounds, to the session's current model, then puts the rewritten prompt back into the draft. No confirm step; the button needs a selected model and is disabled while the draft is empty or a request is running; the write-back replaces the whole draft, including any reference chips in it.
